UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores gamified learner profile, XP progression, daily streak, study metrics, and unlocked achievement badge IDs.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the learner.

displayName.description: Learner display name shown on dashboard and leaderboard.

avatarUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL or preset identifier.

level.description: Current player level calculated from total XP.

xp.description: Total experience points earned across all learning stages.

chaptersCompleted.description: Total count of chapters completed across all subjects.

totalStudyMinutes.description: Cumulative minutes spent studying on LevelUp.

totalQuizzesTaken.description: Total number of stage 5 tests completed.

averageTestScore.description: Average percentage score across completed chapter tests (0-100).

dailyChallengeCompletedDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recently completed daily challenge.

unlockedBadges.description: Bounded list of unlocked achievement badge IDs (max 20).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

ChapterBlueprint.title: ChapterBlueprint
ChapterBlueprint.description: Stores an AI-generated 5-stage gamified learning blueprint for an uploaded document or study topic.

userId.description: UID of the learner who owns this chapter blueprint.

estimatedMinutes.description: Estimated time in minutes to master all five stages.

sourceSummary.description: Executive summary of the uploaded educational material.

completedStages.description: Bounded list of completed stage numbers (1 to 5).

understoodTopicIds.description: Bounded list of topic IDs marked as understood by the learner.

progressPercent.description: Overall completion percentage for the chapter (0 to 100).

xpEarned.description: Total XP earned within this chapter.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the chapter journey.

topics.description: Stage 1 structured topic hierarchy (bounded list of topic objects).

explanations.description: Stage 2 simple explanations, examples, and key concepts.

revisionNotes.description: Stage 3 concise bulleted revision notes and takeaways.

flashcards.description: Stage 3 interactive front/back flashcards and definitions.

mindMap.description: Stage 4 interactive mind map structure with rootLabel and branches.

quizQuestions.description: Stage 5 multiple-choice and true/false assessment questions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chapter blueprint was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chapter blueprint was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Learner profiles and gamification progress indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/chapters/{chapterId}.description: AI-generated 5-stage chapter blueprints owned by individual learners.
